note: GERMAN learning-song library for pipeline.kidsong.lyrics (config kidsong.language='de' + content_mode='learning').

German counterpart of prompts/learning_songs.json. LANGUAGE SPLIT (do not violate): the SUNG/metadata fields (title, description, tags, verses[].lines) are GERMAN; the VISUAL fields verses[].scene_hint, verses[].story_subject and verses[].learning_item stay ENGLISH because they drive the English-trained image/video model and the learning-mode insert shot (director._fallback_planner shows story_subject large and clear, no people). So the child HEARS the item in German and SEES it rendered from the English visual noun. song_style is an English ACE-Step audio caption with 'sung in German' appended.

All lyrics here are ORIGINAL to this channel — not derived from or imitating any existing show, brand or recording. ACE-Step generates a new melody per episode. Each song teaches one item per verse (a letter / number / color / shape / body part), has 2-4 short lines per verse and a repeated German hook line.
